newsitem.title: USA: Gannett to buy Asbury Park Press.
newsitem.headline: Gannett to buy Asbury Park Press.

text.p: Gannett Co. Inc. said Wednesday it has agreed to purchase New Jersey Press Inc., the publisher of the Asbury Park Press and Home News & Tribune newspapers.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The Asbury Park Press, founded in 1879, is the second largest newspaper in New Jersey, with a daily circulation of about 160,000 and 230,000 on Sunday, Gannett said.
The Home News & Tribune, of East Brunswick, N.J., has a daily circulation of about 81,000 and 87,000 on Sunday. New Jersey Press also operates "In Jersey," an Internet service.
Arlington, Va.-based Gannett publishes 89 daily newspapers, including USA Today, and owns 18 television stations and five radio stations.
Gannett stock rose $3.50 to $101.50 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
